📺 Criminal Minds (2005–Present)

Criminal Minds follows an elite team of FBI criminal profilers working within the Behavioral Analysis Unit (BAU), a specialized division dedicated to understanding and capturing some of the most dangerous criminals in the United States. Based in Quantico, Virginia, the team travels across the country investigating disturbing murders, mysterious disappearances, kidnappings, and complicated criminal cases that often leave local law enforcement searching for answers. Rather than focusing solely on physical evidence, the profilers analyze criminal behavior, psychological patterns, personal histories, and crime scenes to understand how offenders think and predict their next moves.
